claim: LLM judges exhibit a greater degree of length bias on multi-turn conversation tasks compared to summarization tasks.
falsifier: The claim can be tested by comparing length bias metrics of LLM judges on multi-turn conversation and summarization tasks.

conditions: Tested on HH-RLHF-Helpfulness dataset for multi-turn conversation and a summarization dataset
exclusions: Evidence is limited to the reported system, task, population, and conditions; transfer beyond them is unestablished.

title: Task type–Degree of length bias principle
